title.zh: Binance Cuts Off SignalPlus API Keys Over 'Potential Security Issue' at Trading Platform
title.en: Binance Cuts Off SignalPlus API Keys Over 'Potential Security Issue' at Trading Platform

current_state.zh: Binance removed all API keys linked to third-party options trading platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, saying its own systems and user funds were unaffected.
current_state.en: Binance removed all API keys linked to third-party options trading platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, saying its own systems and user funds were unaffected.
